method: Assign stages from the score ribbon's segmental chord analysis in saved/local major keys. V7 counts with I and V at Stage 1; other sevenths and extensions remain Stage 6. Count supported roots and actual root/third/seventh tone durations with at least 0.60 chord evidence, 1.5 beats and 3.5% duration support. Retain sparse bass/power-chord evidence, human reviews and saved chord tags. Below 50% segmental coverage retain the legacy estimator under the same V7 policy, reporting every fallback. Curated corpus membership is unchanged. No model fitting.
